description: Permissions for the OIS main window and the windows it opens: Tauri's core defaults, signed auto-update (#347), native notifications (#348), creating / placing / pinning pop-out panels (#349) and whole-route windows (#350), the menu-bar tray (#351) and OS-level global shortcuts (#352). Every window keeps its native title bar (#796), so the OS's own minimize / maximize / close and title-bar drag need no grant here; `close` is for pop-outs and route windows (#349, #350). A notification click raises the window from Rust (src/notify.rs), so the window controls here are for raising an already-open pop-out or route window, not for notification clicks. Tray and menu themselves are already covered by core:default. Pop-out panels get their own, narrower set — see popout.json.
